newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,593 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,593 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,593 contracts compared with 2,455 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 42 wheat, 769 corn, 668 soybean, 95 soymeal, one oat, 499 corn calls, five soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to 2-1/4 cents higher,corn was 1-1/4 to 2-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 3/4 cent to 6-3/4 higher.
